svg.text: Why a 'negative' clinical exome / short-read WGS does NOT rule out SCA12

svg.text: • 55 CAG repeats = 165 bp — LONGER than a standard 150 bp Illumina read (cannot span both flanks!).

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Definitive diagnosis requires targeted Repeat-Primed PCR (RP-PCR), ExpansionHunter/TRGT on long reads (PacBio HiFi / ONT), or Southern blot.
